task.description: Validate the test specification for VLD-01/02/03 (tests/specs/vld-01-03-stage-16-validation.spec.md) before TEST-RUNNER executes. Verify: (1) every MUST acceptance criterion for VLD-01/02/03 has at least one integration test, (2) no test coverage is deferred, (3) fixtures are isolated per test (no shared mutable state), (4) tests are self-sufficient (no reliance on previous test ordering), (5) the pipeline test chain (test files to be added to build.zig + main_test.zig) is correctly wired, (6) the spec covers happy + edge cases. If all PASS, return PASS. If any check fails, return FAIL with specific issues and where to fix.

result.summary: Test design for VLD-01/02/03 validated — all 6 checks pass. Check 1 (every-MUST-AC-has-test): PASS — §1 + §6 coverage matrices list all 15 MUST ACs mapped to named test blocks; cross-checked against design §16 table and requirements.yaml lines 13129-13194. Check 2 (no-deferred-coverage): PASS — §6 explicitly states 'No test is deferred'; the two grep matches on 'deferred' / 'out of scope' are a negative-assertion in §6 and a §7 out-of-scope callout for adjacent modules (VLD-04, PD-02, SPC-02); no TODO/FIXME/phase-2 markers on any MUST AC. Check 3 (fixtures-isolated): PASS — §0 + §2.5: per-test unique names (TC-VLD-<NN>-<suffix> Process), no shared mutable state, defer cleanupDefinition pattern matches the surrounding test corpus. Check 4 (tests-self-sufficient): PASS — env-var gating hard-required (fail-fast not silent-skip); no 'test N assumes test M created X' anywhere; fixtures built in-process. Check 5 (pipeline-wiring-plan): PASS — §5 names the two new files (validation_vld_unit_test.zig + validation_vld_http_test.zig), the main_test.zig imports, and the build.zig addTest + narrow steps (test-integration-vld-unit / test-integration-vld-http) aggregated into test-integration-others-step; matches the SPC-01 pattern in build.zig:2612+. Check 6 (happy-and-edge-cases): PASS — §3 fixtures cover A (clean linear), D (PD-06 syntax violation), F (edit-distance suggestion), G (type mismatch), H (empty expression), J (cross-tenant 404), plus B (forward reachability), C (per-form scope), E (no-match edit-distance), I (13-operator table), K (3-finding aggregate), L (closed-enum wire surface).
